text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios can't wait for winter and 
the Hanshin JF. Plus, she totally wants in 
on that mega-lit 2500m fest, the Arima 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a trial long-distance run alongside 
Mejiro Palmer, it became clear that long 
distances were out of the question. 
Between her focus and aptitude, the 
decision was finalized to focus on sprint 
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mejiro Palmer was troubled by 
the opposite dilemma. As a member of the 
prestigious Mejiro family in the racing 
world, she wonders if she should stick to 
the traditional, orthodox races, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Daitaku Helios tells her the Mejiros 
are the Mejiros and she should do her own 
thing, it hits super hard. She resolves to 
take the path that hypes her up the most.
